name: Food & Drink
seo: Cebu eats across every price point: heritage Filipino kitchens in the old city, specialty coffee bars in IT Park, beachfront grills in Moalboal and Oslob, and the lechon stalls locals actually queue for. We list places we would send a friend to — rated 4.2 and up with enough reviews to trust — with price band, area and opening details on every card, so you can tell a PHP 150 carinderia lunch from a PHP 1,500 tasting menu before you get in a taxi.

subSeo.Restaurants: Filipino kitchens, Japanese and Korean counters, Italian and Mediterranean rooms, plus the lechon and seafood houses locals fill on weekends. Listed with price band and area.
subSeo.Cafes: All-day cafés for breakfast, laptop work and cake — air-conditioning, wifi and a menu that runs past coffee.
subSeo.Coffee: Specialty roasters and espresso bars, from Benguet and Sagada single origins in IT Park to beach-town coffee in Moalboal.
subSeo.Seafood: Grilled fish, crab and prawns by the kilo — market-style paluto rooms and stilted restaurants over the water.
subSeo.Bars & Pubs: Bars where the food matters too: craft beer, cocktails, pub kitchens and beachfront happy hours.
subSeo.Bakery: Bakeries and pâtisseries baking on site — croissants, sourdough, cakes and Filipino pan de sal.

items.name: KYRO Café — Coffee, Breakfast & Pastries in Moalboal
items.address: Panagsama Beach, Moalboal, 6032 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: KYRO Café is a modern, clean, and chill spot in Moalboal, praised for its welcoming staff and comfortable atmosphere. Popular highlights include strong coffee, coconut raf, hearty full breakfasts, and fresh mango yogurt bowls. With reasonable prices, fast service, and a diverse menu, it's an ideal choice for a delicious morning meal or a refreshing stop after a long trip.
items.prices: Coffee from PHP 160, specialty drinks up to PHP 200; breakfasts and mains PHP 330. Average spend PHP 400–600 per person.
items.photoAlt: Breakfast spread at KYRO Café: iced latte, oatmeal with mango, tapsilog and omelette

items.name: Spring Blossom Resto Bar
items.address: Xperiential Spot, Brgy, Basdiot, Moalboal, 6032 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Spring Blossom Resto Bar offers a lively and welcoming atmosphere complete with delicious food, great drinks, and free karaoke. Guests consistently praise the reasonable prices, friendly owner, and accommodating team—making it a fantastic venue for both casual gatherings and large private events. A practical tip for party hosts is to explicitly request proactive table service, such as water refills, so the staff keeps up with your group's specific expectations.

items.name: O Delices French Bakery
items.address: Panagsama Rd, Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: O Delices French Bakery is a charming gem in Moalboal, offering a cozy oasis with both air-conditioned indoor seating and pleasant alfresco dining. Guests rave about the authentic in-house baked pastries, outstanding eggs benedict, delicious pastas, and quality deli selections. It is a perfect spot to recharge after snorkeling with dedicated parking, though visitors should note that it is a cash-only establishment.

items.name: Kamakura
items.address: EC Building, Greenhills Road, Mandaue, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Soba house in Casuntingan, Mandaue, with buckwheat noodles made in-house. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Lantaw (Compostela)
items.address: C2X6+HCC, Compostela, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Open-air native restaurant over the water in Compostela, known for grilled seafood and sunset views. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: LASA BUSAY Modern Filipino Food
items.address: 9VCF+68, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: LASA BUSAY offers incredible modern Filipino cuisine paired with a relaxed atmosphere and astounding panoramic views of Cebu City near the Temple of Leah. Guests rave about the flavorful, beautifully presented dishes—with the crispy fried suman highlighted as a must-try—alongside attentive service and generous portions. It is an ideal spot to recharge during a sightseeing trip, with a convenient car drop-off available at the top to bypass the steep incline from the parking area.

items.name: COCO
items.address: Punta Engaño Rd, Lapu-Lapu, 6015 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Second-floor gem in Mactan Seaport Village with bamboo interiors and a menu mixing Filipino and Thai flavours. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Socarrat
items.address: Faustina Building, Bonifacio District, F. Cabahug St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Spanish comfort food in Bonifacio District — patatas bravas, lengua estofada and paella. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Enye by Chele Gonzalez
items.address: Crimson Resort & Spa Mactan, Seascapes Resort Town, Soong, Lapu-Lapu, 6015 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Spanish cuisine by chef Chele Gonzalez at Crimson Resort & Spa Mactan, classics with contemporary touches. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Sialo
items.address: 7A Pres. Laurel St, Kasambagan, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Sixteen-seat tasting room on President Laurel Street reimagining Filipino flavours; Restaurant of the Year in Best of Cebu 2024. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: DIP
items.address: 82CP+8H, Lapu-Lapu, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Nikkei restaurant at Sheraton Cebu Mactan Resort — Japanese technique with Peruvian accents. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Island Tea Co. & Ceylon Coffee Club
items.address: W9PV+8HP, Santander - Barili - Toledo Rd, Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Island Tea Co. & Ceylon Coffee Club in Moalboal offers a cozy, air-conditioned space with a beautiful interior and fast Wi-Fi, making it a great spot to work or unwind. Visitors consistently praise the outstanding drinks and welcoming atmosphere, though feedback on main food portions can be hit-or-miss. Conveniently located along the Santander-Barili Road, it is best enjoyed for its signature beverages and cafe vibe.

items.name: House of Lechon
items.address: Acacia St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: House of Lechon in Cebu offers a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere paired with exceptionally attentive and warm Filipino hospitality. Diners rave about the legendary lechon with its juicy meat and perfectly crispy skin, as well as standout sides like baked scallops, Langka salad, and buko pandan. Since their famous roast pig can sell out by the evening, it is best to visit earlier in the day to guarantee a taste.

items.name: The Pig and Palm
items.address: G/F, MSY Tower, Negros Rd, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Featuring a stylish, brutalist-inspired interior and a vibrant atmosphere, The Pig & Palm stands out as a memorable dining destination in Cebu despite occasional noise. Guests consistently rave about the freshly baked brioche with chili jam and outstanding pork specialties like the Kurobuta chop, complemented by attentive service and a solid wine list. To get the best experience, skip the polarizing cauliflower salad, stick to their signature pork dishes, and confirm portion sizes if planning to share.

items.name: Abaseria Deli & Cafe
items.address: Villa Aurora Tennis Court, 32 Pres. Quirino St, Kasambagan, Subd, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Home-style café in Kasambagan built around Cebuano heritage recipes — humba, tablea chocolate cake and a deli counter of local produce. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.

items.name: Pares Batchoy Food House
items.address: 12 C. Rodriguez Street, Capitol Site, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Earning a Michelin Bib Gourmand recognition, Pares Batchoy Food House is celebrated for its rich Beef Pares with bone marrow alongside flavorful comfort staples like Pork Sisig and Batchoy. The eatery has a simple, busy atmosphere near local hospitals, though service experiences can range from warm and friendly to a bit brusque. Practical tip: stop by early to try their famous bone marrow dish at reasonable prices, but expect a modest, unpretentious setting.

items.name: Esmen
items.address: 6000, 10 F. Rallos St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Small kitchen on F. Rallos Street in Pasil, cooking Cebuano seafood and market produce at neighbourhood prices. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.

items.name: Maya
items.address: Crossroads Mall, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Modern Mexican kitchen and mezcal bar at Crossroads Mall, Banilad. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Pares Pares
items.address: Unite E, Escario Building, N Escario St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Beef pares specialist on N. Escario Street — slow-braised brisket, garlic rice and clear soup. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: Abli Cebu
items.address: A. Climaco St, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Abli Cebu is a cozy, highly popular spot offering creative and elevated Filipino cuisine set in an artistic, comfortable atmosphere with attentive service. Standout highlights include unique, flavorful sauces, dishes like Crispy Cebu Express and Hmmmmba, and delicious "Morta" desserts. Since the venue is small and operates in timed slots, booking a reservation in advance is essential.

items.name: ATO-AH
items.address: 38 Park Avenue, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Contemporary Filipino dining room in Cebu IT Park, pairing local ingredients with a tasting-menu approach. Michelin Selected 2026.

items.name: CUR8
items.address: Gov. M. Cuenco Ave, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Modern bistro at Banilad Town Center serving refined comfort food with bold Filipino and global flavours. Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026.

items.name: My Greek Taverna
items.address: 411 Panagsama Rd, Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: My Greek Taverna in Moalboal offers a vibrant and welcoming atmosphere enhanced by great music, making it an ideal spot for romantic dates or group dinners. Visitors rave about the flavorful, authentic Mediterranean cuisine, highlighting standout dishes like the tender Tria Souvlaki, savory gyros, and delicious chicken parmigiana. Make sure to save room for their spectacular Bougatsa dessert, and enjoy generous portions paired with friendly service at very reasonable prices.
